header.name: Technology and the Future of Work
header.description: This course traces the link between technological shifts and transformations in work from a sociological perspective. It traces the history of these changes through the early periods of capitalism, to expansion of domestic technology and ultimately to analyse the possibilities of the future where digital technology and automatic is expected to transform society . The course will equip students in analysing these changes from the perspective of its impacts on society, including the changing nature of work itself, its impact on social identity based work, and analyse whether the future of work entails joblessness or expanded leisure for all.

outcomes.label: CO1
outcomes.raw_text: Students can recognise the historical development of technology and its advance under capitalist society.

outcomes.label: CO2
outcomes.raw_text: Students can explain the manner in which technological shifts intersect with social relations

outcomes.label: CO3
outcomes.raw_text: Students can analyse the construction of technology from a sociological perspective

outcomes.label: CO4
outcomes.raw_text: Students can evaluate and develop original arguments related to the 'future of work' and the relationship between technology and society from different theoretical perspectives.
